Label.name: strong
Label.Definition: Backed by RCT, peer-reviewed research, or verified data at scale
Label.LanguagePattern: Can state with certainty: "X results in Y" or "Studies show..."

Label.name: medium
Label.Definition: Supported by observational data, case studies, or expert consensus
Label.LanguagePattern: Use probabilistic language: "Most users report..." or "Often leads to..."

Label.name: light
Label.Definition: Anecdotal evidence, testimonials, or theoretical basis
Label.LanguagePattern: Frame as experience: "Many people find..." or "Users report..."

Claim.Text: Most users report improved outcomes within specified timeframe based on verified user data
Approach aligns with established research in the field
Claim.UsageGuidance: Frame as "based on" or "consistent with" research
Present as testimonial or user experience, not universal outcome

Claim.Alternative: Can say "supports" or "may help with" with disclaimer
Use "most users" or specific percentage with typical results disclosure
Frame as "effective approach" or "addresses root cause"

Evidence.Title: Founder Personal Transformation

Summary.Bullet: Founder experienced the same problem for X years
Tried conventional solutions without lasting success

Evidence.UsageGuidance: Use for relatability and credibility; frame as personal journey, not universal proof
Evidence.Caveats: Personal experience; establishes credibility but not scientific validation

Evidence.Title: Peer-reviewed research on mechanism

Summary.Bullet: Key findings relevant to your mechanism

Evidence.UsageGuidance: Use to validate mechanism; can cite directly with proper attribution
Evidence.Caveats: Study context may differ from product application; cite accurately

Evidence.Title: Additional supporting research
Evidence.UsageGuidance: Use for additional credibility; combine with E02 for stronger case
Evidence.Caveats: General research, not specific to product

Evidence.Title: Verified User Results - Aggregate Data
Evidence.UsageGuidance: Can state specific percentages; include typical results disclosure
Evidence.Caveats: Self-reported data; include typical results disclosure per FTC guidelines

Evidence.Title: Featured User: [Name K.]
Evidence.UsageGuidance: Use for social proof; present as individual experience with typical results disclosure
Evidence.Caveats: Individual results; must include "results not typical" or similar disclosure

Evidence.Title: Featured User: [Name T.]
Evidence.UsageGuidance: Use for diversity of proof; shows different paths to success

Evidence.Title: Detailed Case Study: [Specific Example]

Summary.Bullet: Intervention: [what they did, how they used product]

Evidence.UsageGuidance: Use for detailed proof; shows mechanism in action
Evidence.Caveats: Single case; representative but not universal

Evidence.Title: Money-Back Guarantee Policy

Summary.Bullet: What they keep: [any components they retain]

Evidence.UsageGuidance: Use for objection handling; shows confidence in product
Evidence.Caveats: Must honor exactly as stated; legal commitment

Strong.Snippet: Based on verified data from [X] users...

Testimonial.Snippet: Results not typical. Individual outcomes vary.

Disclaimer.Snippet: These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Individual results may vary. Testimonials represent individual experiences and are not guarantees of results.
Typical results: [state realistic range based on data]

Check.name: unsupported_claim_flag
Check.Rule: Every claim must reference at least one Evidence ID
Check.Action: Flag claim, require evidence or reframe with probabilistic language

Check.name: certainty_without_strong_evidence_fail
Check.Action: Downgrade to probabilistic language or escalate

Check.name: testimonial_presented_as_universal
Check.Action: Add "results not typical" or similar disclosure

Check.name: medical_claim_without_disclaimer
Check.Rule: Any health-related claim requires FDA disclaimer

Check.name: disallowed_claim_present
Check.Rule: Claims in DisallowedClaims list must not appear
Check.Action: Remove or replace with approved alternative

FTC_Guidelines.Note: All testimonials require typical results disclosure
Income claims require proof of typical results
Before/after images must be genuine and representative

FDA_Guidelines.Note: Health claims require substantiation or disclaimer
Cannot claim to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease without approval
Structure/function claims allowed with proper disclaimer
